title: Fractional laser skin rejuvenation
what: The laser makes many tiny microscopic dots in the skin. The skin renews itself and becomes smoother and firmer.
why: For fine wrinkles, uneven skin texture, enlarged pores, acne scars and pigmentation.
duration: the procedure usually takes 30 to 60 minutes with numbing; recovery takes from a few days to 1 to 2 weeks
tell_doctor: If you have had cold sores (herpes) on your face - sometimes a medicine is given beforehand
If you have been in the sun recently
If you have had keloid scars
All your medicines and skin products, especially retinoids

prepare.title: Sun
prepare.text: Do not sunbathe before the procedure. Ask the clinic how long to avoid it.

prepare.title: Skin products
prepare.text: Strong skin creams are sometimes stopped a few days before. Your doctor will tell you.

prepare.title: Numbing
prepare.text: A numbing cream is usually applied 30 to 60 minutes before.

prepare.title: Time
prepare.text: Plan a few days at home: your face will be red and swollen.

steps: Your skin is cleaned and numbing cream is applied
You wait for it to take effect
The cream is wiped off and you put on protective goggles
The doctor passes the laser over your skin, area by area
feel: Warmth and tingling, like after a sunburn
Afterwards the skin is red, swollen and hot
after: Redness and peeling usually last 3 to 7 days
Use only the products your doctor told you to
Do not pick at crusts or flakes
Use sunscreen every day for several months
red_flags: Blisters, severe pain, pus or fever - see a doctor
Patches that get darker after a few weeks - see a doctor

faq.q: When will I see the result?
faq.a: The first changes appear after 1 to 2 weeks. The full result takes a few months.

faq.q: How many sessions do I need?
faq.a: Usually from one to several, a few weeks apart. Your doctor will tell you what your skin needs.

reminders.text: Fractional laser tomorrow. Stay out of the sun and set aside a few days to recover.
